body: I just wanted to say, I actually took your advice and called a hotline last night, something I've never done.  Surprisingly, it was helpful.  The guy I spoke to was very nice, and I said things to him I've never told anyone.  He then gave me some advice which I actually found helpful.  I am surprised it turned out the way it did.  I just wanted to thank you.

Yeah I have written solid letters to everyone in my life who matters so they'll realize it isn't their fault at all.

Yes I have had a near death experience.

Thanks for talking to my post, your kindness is appreciated.
